next_step: Start 2-week POC on Hosted API; deliver perf + cost report; follow-up Dedicated sizing call week of 2026-03-22
notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B analytics SaaS (product analytics + in-app assistant). Heavy interactive chat and embeddings for product search. Currently using OpenAI for chat + embeddings; looking to reduce unit cost and get predictable regional capacity.

Rationale for Redwood: interest in Hosted API as low-friction migration path, then move to Dedicated for committed throughput and data isolation. Cares about 'same prompts, same outputs' — prompt parity is the #1 non-functional requirement.

Customer quotes: 'We need parity with our current prompts — we can't ship regressions to customers', 'Latency spikes during peak usage are killing UX', 'We want a path to dedicated capacity without rearchitecting request routing.'
Engagement so far: discovery call (2026-02-22), product demo (2026-03-05), security questionnaire submitted (2026-03-08), pricing sync (2026-03-10). AE + SE alignment ongoing.

Commercial posture: price-sensitive but willing to commit for predictable unit economics. Interested in model recommendations and quantization options from Redwood Optimize to reduce cost on Dedicated.

POC asks from Tritium: 2-week Hosted API POC using a canonical prompt set (provided), streaming parity check, function-call mapping, and embedding/semantic-search baseline vs OpenAI. Need token accounting and cost delta report.
Legal/security: SSO via SAML required for all admin users; SOC2 compliance and audit logs required for procurement; potential data residency requirement for EU customers (regional routing).

Notes on migration: They expect a compatibility layer to handle function calling differences and system-tokenization changes. Concerned about small semantic regressions from model family differences (e.g., openai->redwood-curated-llm).
Internal: AE Priya coordinating with Miguel (SE). CSM TBD if we progress to Dedicated. Budget owner is VP Product (Elena Park).
Stated timeline: want POC results by end of March 2026 to make a Q2 decision on Dedicated commit.

technical_requirements: Workloads: 60% chat (interactive product assistant), 30% embeddings for search, 10% reranking for recommendations
Latency targets: P95 < 300ms for short-turn chat (<=128 tokens), tail performance critical for user-facing assistant
Throughput targets: steady-state 120 QPS embeddings, burst to 400 QPS during release-windows
Model constraints: require model version pinning and ability to fallback to cheaper quantized variants under load
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-prompt latency histograms, error tracing to request ids
poc_success_criteria: Functional parity for canonical prompt set (<=5% metric drift vs baseline LLM outputs as judged by product team)
End-to-end P95 latency improvement or parity with current prod (no regressions in tail)
Measured per-token cost reduction vs current provider (hosted POC target >=15% savings)
Zero-critical-security-findings in questionnaire; SSO and audit-log integration validated
migration_risks: Prompt-parity regressions due to model family differences and tokenization changes
Function-calling mapping differences (naming/typing) causing integration work
Streaming and chunking behavior differences impacting frontend UX
Billing/token accounting differences during POC causing cost estimation errors
Legal review of new TOS/cross-border data flows could delay Dedicated commit
